title: First classifier protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for First classifier should complete this objective: Train a classifier on the Iris dataset. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand fit() and predict().), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Use a reproducible split; report the metric and one limitation.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for load_iris, fit(, predict( and does not run the learner code. Use a reproducible split; report the metric and one limitation.
